Commentary.Commentary: Anukul Roy once again put the cat among the pigeons and kept the batsmen guessing with his shrewd variations. Followed up his match-winning performance with a 4-fer and also stemmed the run-flow. Mavi, Singh and Sharma were also on the money. Apart from the 49-run stand between Shumba and Roche, nothing significant to talk about the Men in Red's batting. Should be an easy chase for the Men in Blue but you never know. A few quick wickets might test the middle order. Join us shortly.

A clinical bowling performance from India to restrict Zimbabwe to a paltry total. The bowlers were disciplined from the word go and maintained the same intensity throughout the innings to choke the opposition batsmen. Only three batsmen went past the 30-run mark. This proves that the African side was found wanting against the swing, bounce and pace of the pacers and also struggled to come to terms with the purchase extracted by the spinners.

OUT! 4-wicket haul for Anukul Roy! Too good for the No. 10! Nungu uses his feet and Roy fires it in on spotting that. Nungu yorks himself but still goes for a big swing across the line and misses it completely to hear the death rattle. ZIMBABWE ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 154!
Nkosilathi Nungu is in some discomfort. He is lying down on the ground and the physio attends him.
Full delivery well outside off, Connolly swings hard at it but misses.

Short ball on middle and leg, it's the off cutter at 116 clicks. Nkosilathi Nungu goes for the pull but misses to get hit on the helmet. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batsmen sneak in a leg bye.
Fullish ball attacking the stumps, blocked off the front foot.
Fullish ball and going down leg, Connolly gets some bat on it as the ball rolls behind square leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, played with an open bat face to the point region.
Shortish ball outside off, Connolly drops his wrists to let it be.
Fullish delivery, clipped to mid on and the batsmen set off. Nagarkoti dives to his left and fires in a throw to the keeper but the batsman makes it in.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Floated ball, kept out watchfully.

A stifled appeal for a caught behind turned down! Floated around middle and leg, Nungu swings across the line but misses. The ball lobs off the pads and Desai comes in front to take it. Appeals politely but the umpire stays put. No bat on that.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Drifting towards the pads, Nkosilatu tries to defend it but is hit on the pads. Going down leg this time.
Anukul Roy comes back for a bowl.
Singh comes from around the wicket and bowls a good length ball on off. Defended solidly off the back foot.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On a length on middle and leg, Connolly stays back and taps it to mid on.
Short ball on middle, Nunu goes for the pull but is hit on the shoulder and the ball deflects towards third man. A leg bye taken.
Searches for the yorker but ends up bowling a low full toss outside off, Connolly pushes at it but gets an outside edge to third man for a run.
Jonathan Connolly is the last man in.

OUT! What a ripper of a delivery! It was good to even get a top-order batsman. Pinpoint yorker, tailing in with the assistance of the wind. Harrison clears his front leg, tries to jam it out but falls over towards the off side. Is hit right on his right boot. As soon as the Indians appeal, the umpires' finger goes up instantly. Arshdeep Singh is absolutely pumped up.
Change of bat for Harrison.
On a flatter trajectory on middle, Nunu buries it into the track.
Fullish on middle and leg, helped through square leg for a run. 150 up for Zimbabwe.
Sliding in this time, clipped with the angle to mid on.
Fullish ball, eased to mid off for a brisk run.
Prods forward to this one and tucks it defensively to mid-wicket.
Coming in with the arm, defended stoutly off the front foot.
Another off cutter outside off, Taun tries to dab it but gets beaten for pace.
Full length ball attacking the stumps, kept out watchfully.
Back of a length outside off, played off the outer half to third man for a run.
Well-disguised slower ball! Off cutter on a shorter length on middle and leg, Nunu goes for the pull but is early into his shot. Is hit on the helmet and the ball goes into the gloves of the keeper.
Fractionally overpitched around off, patted to the cover region.
Fullish delivery on off, Nunu comes forward and blocks it solidly.
Arshdeep Singh returns for a bowl.
Loopy delivery, Taun lunges forward in defense.
FOUR! Shot! Short ball outside off, Harrison rocks back and cuts it past backward point to find the fence.
Coming in with the arm, Harrison plays for the turn but gets beaten.
Slow through the air, defended solidly off the front foot.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Floated outside off, Taun pushes at it but misses.
Nkosilathi Nungu comes out to bat. Meanwhile, Shiva Singh comes back for a bowl.

OUT! Gone! Sharma gets his second wicket. Nenhunzi shapes for the fancy reverse sweep and Sharma bowls it full on middle and leg. The batsman fails to execute the shot and is hit flush on the pads. The Indians appeal in unison and up goes the umpire's finger. However, Nenhunzi is really disappointed. We realize the reason for it now. The replays show that the ball brushed his gloves on its way through. Unlucky.
Driven through covers for a run again.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! A welcome boundary for Zimbabwe! Drifting down the leg side, Nenhunzi kneels and sweeps it past the man at backward square leg to find the fence.
Bowls this one very slow through the air, Harrison leans ahead and strokes it to sweeper cover to rotate strike.
Tossed up ball, pushed against the spin to the cover region.
Wide! Drifting down the leg side, Harrison tries to play it defensively but misses. Good take by Desai.
A play and a miss! Very full outside off, Nenhunzi tries to carve it away square of the wicket on the off side but gets beaten.
Low full toss outside off, Harrison chases it but gets it off the outer half of the bat towards third man. A run taken.
Length delivery, takes off and shapes away appreciably as well. Harrison fishes at it but gets foxed.
Wide! Shortish delivery well outside off, Taun doesn't bother to play at it.
Good length ball, moving away after pitching. Harrison doesn't fiddle with it.
On a length, angling away, tapped with an open bat face towards point.
Beaten for pace! Fullish delivery, tailing in sharply. Nenhunzi tries to keep it out but gets an inside edge past his stumps towards fine leg. A run taken.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Five fielders are allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.
Goes deep in the crease and dabs it towards short third man.
Floats it up outside off, driven towards cover.
Darts it on the leg stump, blocked off the front foot.
Taun Harrison walks out next.

OUT! Lovely delivery! Abhishek Sharma gets his first wicket! Loops it up around off, Frost in his quest to score some runs, dances down the track to go big. However, the ball turns past him, beats the outside edge and Harvik Desai does the rest behind the stumps who has been really good today.
Quicker one outside off, cut away towards cover for a single.
Leans forward and pushes it towards point.
Fuller and angling in on off, defended with an open blade to point. Just 1 off it. Excellent over from Kamlesh.
Beaten! On a back of a length and outside off, Frost hangs his bat out and the ball nearly kisses the outside edge of his bat.
Wide! Another bumper but this one kicks off a bit too much and rightly called as a wide.
Short of a length again, blocked.
Short ball, kicking off the surface, Frost is hurried by it as he hops to fend it away but misses. The ball hits him on the chest and lobs towards the vacant silly point region.
Back of a length on middle, punched off the back foot to the bowler.
What a delivery! Nagarkoti fires in a pinpoint yorker on the stumps, Frost just about manages to keep it out.
Around middle and leg, Tinashe sweeps but finds the man at square leg.
Shimmies down the track and defends it towards cover.
Gets down and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Quicker and shorter outside off, slapped off the back foot towards backward point.
Flatter delivery on the stumps, punched past the bowler down to long on for one.
Floats it up around middle and leg, defended by prodding forward.
Abhishek Sharma is recalled.
Pounds in a short one outside off, Frost drops his wrists to let it be.

FOUR! Edged but intentional! Frost tries to use the pace of Kamlesh. He stands back, opens the bat face and looks to run it down to third man. Gets it off the outer edge which is called as an educated edge. A boundary results!
Nagarkoti comes running in but bails out just when he was about to deliver...
Goes full but it's wider outside off, drilled towards sweeper cover for a single.
Bangs in a short one and gets lovely bounce, Nenhunzi ducks to evade it.
Another one defended off the front foot.
Fuller in length and served on off, Nenhunzi defends it nicely off the front foot.
Kamlesh Nagarkoti is back into the attack.
Gives it nice air and lands it full on off, TN drives it towards long off to keep strike.
Loops it up outside off, blocked into the ground again.
Quicker delivery on the pads, defended into the leg side.
Defended solidly off the front foot by Nenhunzi.
Tossed up outside off, driven down to long off for a single.
Takes a stride forward and pushes it towards the cover fielder.
Follows it up with a pitched up ball well outside off, the batsman chases it but gets beaten.
Well-directed! Sharp bouncer at 141 clicks, angling in, Nenhunzi arches his back and sways away from the line of the delivery to evade it.
On a length outside off, Frost steers it to third man to rotate strike.
Good running! Goes deep in the crease and plays the back of the length ball towards cover-point for a brisk single.
Hangs back to the good length ball and defends it stoutly.
Back of a length outside off, Nenhunzi taps it through point and returns for a brace.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Prods forward and blocks it out watchfully.
Alistair Frost walks out next.
Drinks are on the field.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Anukul Roy missed a run out chance in the previous over but it doesn't matter as he comes and removes him of his own bowling. He bowls it quicker through the air and it skids off the surface to breach Roche's defense and shatters the stumps behind.
Eased down to long off for a single.
Nenhunzi prods forward to keep this one out.
Tossed up outside off, driven towards the cover fielder.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Direct hit and Roche would have been a goner! Slightly short and outside off, Roche cuts it towards backward point where Anukul Roy dives full length to his left to make a good stop. Liam sets off but his partner sends him back after he is halfway down the track. Roy has a shy at the striker's end but misses it completely. Had he hit, the Zimbabwean skipper would have been sent packing as he was not even in the frame.
SIX! Boom! Shortish delivery, angling in on the body, Roche moves across the line and pulls it off the meat to send it over the deep square leg fence for a maximum.
Shortish and just outside off, Roche looks to cut but chops it towards backward point.
Touch short and outside off, Roche looks to pull but fails to get any wood on it.
Back of a length outside off, tapped off the front foot towards cover.
Shivam Mavi is back on.
On a flatter trajectory, dealt off the back foot. An eventful over this!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tinashe Nenhunzi is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Roy is turning it on here! Second wicket in the over! Zimbabwe in dire straits now! India rejoice! Anukul bowls it quicker through the air from around the wicket and it skids off the deck and stays a touch low too. Chimhinya goes back to defend but misses to get pinged on the pads right in front of the stumps. They appeal and the umpire has no qualms in raising his finger.
Gets forward and bunts it back to Roy.
Robert Chimhinya walks in next.

OUT! Stumped! Anukul Roy gets his man! After getting hit for a maximum on the previous ball, he nicely slows it up through the air. Milton Shumba lunges forward to defend but misses and in the process also loses his balance. Harvik Desai behind the stumps is quick to take the bails off. He appeals and is really confident. They take it upstairs and replays show Milton has nothing behind the line. The 49-run stand is broken.
Is Shumba a goner? Harvik Desai has removed the bails quickly and a stumping appeal has been taken upstairs...
SIX! With the turn and it's a maximum! Floats it up outside off, Shumba gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it with the turn over mid-wicket for half a dozen.

Slow through the air around off, Shumba tries to defend it but the ball goes off the outer half towards point. The batsmen call for a run and the keeper sprints towards the ball. Scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but the batsman is home.
Gets forward and blocks the flighted ball right under his nose.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Ooh.. tentative! Quicker ball, spinning in. Shumba pushes at it with hard hands and gets an inside edge towards square leg. A run taken.
Leans ahead to the tossed up ball and pats it to the left side of the bowler.
Slider this time, tucked around the corner for a single.
Flighted ball in line of the stumps, Roche milks it down to long on for a run and will retain strike. 100 up for Zimbabwe.
Fullish ball, knocked down to long on for a run.
Shumba is nimble on his feet and drives this one to the man at extra cover.
Sits deep in the crease and places it through point for a single.
A play and a miss! Shorter in length, spinning away and stays a bit low. Roche goes for the cut but gets beaten.
Fullish on middle and leg, clipped to the man at square leg.
Spinning into Milton. He lunges forward and smothers the spin. Only 2 from the over, Singh continues to be frugal.
Quicker and flatter outside off, played with an angled blade to point.
Flighted ball, Shumba lunges forward in defense.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shorter in length, cut with the spin through cover-point for a run.
Drifting towards the pads, helped down to fine leg for a single.
Shiva Singh comes back into the attack. His figures read 4-0-4-0.
Leans ahead and pats this one with the spin to covers.
Coming in with the arm, tucked to mid-wicket.
Loopy delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Slider this time, played with the angle through mid on for a single.
Marginally short, cut with the spin through point for a single.
On a flatter trajectory, answered with a straight bat.
Fullish ball, knocked down to long on for a single. 6 singles from the over.
Gets right to the pitch of the delivery and caresses it through extra cover to get off strike.
Drifting towards the pads, tucked around the corner for a run.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side. They pick up a single.
Roche drives this flighted ball against the spin to sweeper cover for a run.
Floated ball, clipped through mid on for a single.
Roche places this one through cover-point for a brace.
Tossed up ball, worked to long on to rotate strike.
Spinning in, played defensively to the man at mid-wicket.
Coming in with the arm, played with the angle through mid-wicket for a run.
Slow through the air, caressed through mid on to get off strike.
Sits deep in the crease and milks this one down to long on for a single.
Anukul Roy to bowl now. He took a 5-wicket haul in India's previous match. Can he replicate the performance?
Marginally short, cut with the spin to sweeper cover for a single and Roche will retain strike.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Darted well outside off on a fullish length, Shumba drives it hard to sweeper cover for a single.
Leans forward confidently to the loopy ball and pushes it back to the bowler.
Allows the ball to spin into him and stonewalls it.
Fullish ball, eased down the track.
Fails to find the gap! Short delivery, cut hard but finds the man at backward point. Another tidy over.
On a flatter trajectory on middle, knocked down to long on to rotate strike.
In line of the stumps, Milton defends this one stoutly.
Quicker in pace, dealt from within the crease.
Slow through the air, defended solidly off the front foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up ball, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Lovely! Quicker through the air around off, Roche pushes at it with hard hands but gets beaten.
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh pad.

Not Out! Shumba tucks it towards square leg and sets off. Arshdeep is quick to attack the ball and hits the bull's eye at the bolwer's end as the batsman rushes in. It is taken upstairs. Replays find Shumba fine.
A run out appeal at the bowler's end is taken upstairs. The batsman seems to be safe though.
Floated ball, milked to long off for a single.
Spinning into Shumba who works it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Abhishek Sharma comes on for a bowl.
Full on middle, drifting in, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Quick and flat on middle, clipped nicely to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Similar ball, pushed back to the bowler.
On a flatter trajectory, Roche sits deep in the crease and defends it down the track.
Covers the line to the tossed up ball and pats it to the off side.
Coming in with the arm, punched against the angle to sweeper cover for a run.
Beaten! Back of a length and room on offer, Roche goes for a full-blooded slash but misses.
Continues to pound the deck hard, Shumba rises on his toes and tucks it with soft hands to mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Around the hips this time, tucked with a hop around the corner for a single.
Short ball on middle and leg, the skipper pulls it to deep square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Just a mere push and the ball whistles away to the fence. Fuller in length on middle, Roche knocks it past the bowler. The timing is spot on and the ball rolls to the long on fence.
Back of a length ball on off, angling in, kept out watchfully.
Stays back and punches it wide of the man at mid-wicket for a single. 3 runs and a wicket off it.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Flattish around off, Roche cuts it off the outer half towards point.
Slider around middle and leg, Milton looks to push it away but gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted ball around off, driven through cover for a single to get off strike.
Liam Nicholas Roche walks in next.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Death rattle, shouts Ian Bishop on air! Riyan Parag lets out a huge roar! He slides in an arm ball, gets it to skid a touch, Wesley Madhevere crouches low to dab it fine but the length wasn't an ideal one. Ends up chopping it back onto the stumps. They once again check for the front foot no ball but Parag had enough behind the line.
Shortish and served outside off, slapped square of the wicket on the off side for a single to keep strike.
Hits the length hard, around middle and off, WS hops and tucks it away.
Wide! Bangs in a short one but it's way down the leg side as the batsman ducks under it.
Good length delivery on off, defended off the front foot.
Slants it on a length outside off, slapped through backward point for a single.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Fuller and angling in on the pads, flicked towards deep square leg for a single.
Kamlesh Nagarkoti is back on.
FOUR! Downtown goes Wesley! Floats it up on the stumps, Madhevere stays leg side and lofts it cleanly over mid off. A couple of bounces and into the fence she goes. Safest place to hit.
Tosses it up around off, Wesley looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Fuller on middle, milked down to long on for a single.
Slower and angling in, driven square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Flatter one on the stumps, punched towards wide long on for a single.
Floats it up around middle and leg, worked away towards mid-wicket.
Bowls a yorker around off, the batsman fails to jam it out.
Stands tall and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish and outside off, cut through point for a single.

That nearly cost India Five Bonus Runs! Angles it on the pads, Shumba misses his tuck as the ball goes off the pads towards the right of Harvik Desai. He dives to stop but it goes off the gloves and nearly rolls towards the helmet behind before the keeper stops it. A leg bye taken.
On a length and hurled outside off, holds its line, the batsman pokes at it tentatively and gets beaten. The keeper underarms a throw at the striker's end but the batsman was easily in.
Back of a length delivery outside off, steered with an angled bat towards the point fielder.
Drinks are on the field.
Tossed up on off, Madhevere drives it towards cover and sets off. Seeing it's going straight to the fielder there, Shumba sends him back on time. Good first over, just 3 off it.
A bit flatter on middle and off, defended from within the crease.
Goes back and punches it back to Parag who fumbles and concedes a single.
Around middle and leg, wristed towards mid-wicket.
Drops it short and serves it outside off, slapped uppishly through backward point for a couple of runs.
Slower through the air, lands it around middle, Shumba lunges forward to defend but there is a bit of extra bounce. The ball hits the high portion of the bat and dies down.
Riyan Parag is brought in to roll his arm over.
Fuller and angling in from around the wicket, Madhevere comes forward and drives it towards mid on.
Short of a length delivery on middle, helped with a pull through mid-wicket for a single.
A full toss, swinging back in on middle and leg, the batsman keeps his calm as he just pushes it back down the track.
Shortish on off, Shumba swivels to pull it away but fails to put any bat on it.
Drags his length back a touch on middle, MS shows a straight bat in defense.
Slightly fuller and arrowing in on middle, turned towards the leg side.
Gets across a touch does Milton and works it through square leg for a single to keep strike.
Loopy ball around off, Shumba defends it down.
Gets on the front foot and drives it down to long off for a single.
Takes a stride forward and drives it towards cover.
Gives it nice revs, lands it full on off, pushed off the front foot to the cover fielder.
Flighted delivery around middle and leg, Madhevere looks to turn it around the corner but ekes an inside edge on the pads.
Good shot! Ahead of a length around middle and off, Milton stands tall and lofts it over Arshdeep's head. Gets a couple before the man from mid on mops it up.
Switches to over the wicket and hurls a length delivery on middle, it skids a touch and pings Shumba on the pads.
Back of a length delivery, straying a bit on the pads, clipped by getting across the line. The ball rolls towards fine leg and they take a single.
Bangs in a short one but the angle is down the leg side, Madhevere once again ducks under it.
Goes around the wicket and angles it in on middle and leg, a gentle push towards mid on.
Shortish delivery on the leg stump, Madhevere is quick to sit under it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

A shout for an LBW! Comes from over the wicket and loops it  up around off, Milton prods forward in defense but misses to get hit on the pads. They appeal but the umpire turns it down. Maybe, the impact was an issue there.
Makes some room and drives it past the man at cover for a single this time.
Loopy delivery outside off, pushed off the front foot towards the cover fielder.
Around middle and leg, worked with soft hands towards mid-wicket.
Floats it up around middle and off, defended off the front foot.
Milton Shumba is the new man in.

OUT! Change of the angle works for Arshdeep Singh! He strikes in his very first over! Comes from around the wicket and pitches it up around off, Myers looks to chip it down the ground but mistimes it towards mid off. Prithvi Shaw stationed there accepts a dolly. Hold on, they check for the side crease no ball. But Singh's foot didn't cut that. Fair delivery and Myers continues to walk.
Shortish on middle and off, Myers defends it gently off the back foot.
Stands tall and steers it through backward point for a single.
Ahead of a length outside off, Wesley punches it off the back foot to the cover fielder.
Good length delivery on off, blocked off the front foot towards cover.
Starts off with a short of a length delivery, it rises a touch off the deck, Madhevere hops and defends it off the splice of the bat towards the leg side.
Powerplay 2 is signalled. Maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle. Also, Arshdeep Singh comes on to bowl.
Quick and flat on off, defended solidly off the back foot. Tidy over, only 1 from it.
Sliding down leg, Myers tries to glance it but misses. That should have have been given a wide.
What a ripper! Just missed the off pole. On a flatter trajectory on off, grips the surface and spins away. Myers pushes at it with minimal foot movement and the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
Coming in with the arm, stroked to mid off for a single.
Slow through the air, eased to the same region.
Tossed up on off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Hit with authority this time! Importantly, he found the gap. Short again, asking to be hit. Myers rises on his toes and flays it between backward point and gully to find the fence.

Dropped! A pretty tough chance though. Short and room on offer, Madhevere slaps it uppishly towards the gully region. Abhishek Sharma stationed there dives to his left but the ball bursts through his hands and rolls to third man. A run taken.
Shortish ball outside off, steered with an open bat face towards gully.
Shortish delivery on middle and leg, pulled all along the ground towards deep square leg for a brace.
Another play and a miss! Back of a length outside off, stays a touch low. Madhevere flats at it but misses.
Coming in with the arm, swept off the inner half to the man at 45.

Not Out! Tossed up nicely on off, turning away sharply. Myers goes for a drive but gets beaten. Desai is sharp as a hawk to collect it and takes the bails off. It is referred upstairs. The replays find that the batsman's back foot is grounded.
There is a stumping appeal against Myers. Good glovework from Harvik Desai. The batsman seems to be safe though.
Sits deep in the crease and keeps this one out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On a flatter trajectory, skids off after pitching. Myers pushes at it but gets it off the outer half towards cover-point.
Tossed up delivery on a full length on off, Myers lunges forward in defense.
Time for spin. Shiva Singh to roll his arm over now. A slip in place.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Wesley makes a watchful leave.
On a driveable length outside off, holding its line. Madhevere plants his front foot across and makes a watchful leave.
This is poor bowling! Again on a short of a length and width on offer. Steered past the man at gully this time. The man in the deep runs to his right and mops it up. A couple taken.
Nicely done! Short of a length outside off, Wesley places it past backward point and returns for a brace.
Length delivery outside off, blocked solidly off the front foot.
Back of a length outside off, Wesley rises up on his toes and plays it with an angled bat to point.
Too straight this time, easy pickings for Dion who clips it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Fullish ball wide outside off, left alone.
This one kept a bit low! Shortish and width on offer, Dion flays at it but is foxed by the low bounce this time.
In the air... but safe! Good length ball on middle and leg, a bit of extra bounce on that. Myers hops and tucks it uppishly but it goes on the bounce to Shiva Singh at mid-wicket.
Similar length outside off, steered smartly past the left side of the backward point fielder for a run. Nagarkoti is bowling with good pace but has been a bit wayward with his line and length.
A play and a miss! Shortish and outside off, Madhevere tries to play it with a horizontal bat but gets beaten.
Good length ball around off, shaping in. Myers covers the line and pats it besides the pitch on the off side.
Wide! Once again it is well outside off, in fact outside the tramline. Myers has nothing to do with it.
Hurled way outside off, Dion doesn't flirt with it.
In the zone outside off, holding its line. Myers remains circumspect in approach to let it through.
Slip comes out and moves to mid-wicket.
Similar length ball, coming in appreciably, answered with a straight bat.
Well bowled! Back of a length ball on off, pushes Myers deep in the crease. He tries to keep it out but the ball hits the splice of the bat and dies down on the track.
Fullish delivery outside off, Myers puts his head down and defends it calmly.
Beautifully bowled! On a length around off, seams away after pitching. Wesley pushes at it gingerly and the ball whizzes past his outside edge. 8 from the over, good one for Zimbabwe.
FOUR! Slashes and slashes hard! Short and room on offer, Madhevere stands tall and crashes it through point. That goes to the fence like a tracer bullet.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! All about timing and grace! Short of a length outside off, enough width for Madhevere to free his arms. He rises on his toes and crunches it past the diving cover-point fielder to find the fence.
Good length ball in the avenue of apprehension, angling in, defended stoutly off the back foot.
Shortish and a bit of room on offer, cut away to the point region.
FOUR! Sublime! Fuller in length around off, swinging in, Myers strides forward and creams it with the full face of the bat through the cover region for a boundary and gets off the mark as well.
Length delivery outside off, seaming in, Myers makes an assured leave.
Fullish delivery, swinging in, pushed defensively to the man at mid off.
In the channel outside off, a bit of nibble in the air, left alone.
Dion Myers comes out to bat.

OUT! Mavi draws first blood! What a ripper of a delivery to catch Gregory off guard. Steams in from over the wicket and bowls a good length delivery in the zone of apprehension, gets prodigious swing. Dollar is caught in a tangle and tries to drive it away from the body but misses the line completely to get his off stump shattered. Mavi is bowling into the wind and it is not easy to control the movement. Credit to him for using it to his advantage. Ideal start for the Men in Blue.
Back of a length on off, Gregory hangs back and defends it back to the bowler.
Fullish delivery, shaping in, pushed off the front foot to mid off. Tidy start from Nagarkoti.
That's a peach! Good seam presentation! In the corridor of uncertainty at 145 clicks, seams away after pitching. Madhevere pokes at it with minimal feet movement and is beaten all ends up.
Shortish delivery outside off, lifts after pitching. Wesley points his bat skywards to make an assured leave.
Leg bye! Good length ball, angling in, Gregory tries to clip it but the ball brushes his pads and rolls past the keeper. The batsmen sneak in a run.
Good probing channel! Fullish delivery, curving in. Dollar strides forward and presents a water-tight defense.
This one swings the other way. The batsman is alert to it and works it to fine leg to open his account with a single.
Wide! On a length outside off, swinging away sharply. Madhevere has nothing to do with it.
Kamlesh Nagarkoti to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Short of a length on off, kept out watchfully. End of an eventful first over.

FOUR! Textbook stuff from Dollar and Zimbabwe are away in style! Fractionally overpitched on middle, Dollar strides forward and caresses it past mid on for a glorious boundary. Everything right about that shot - high elbow, good head position and ideal extension of arms.
Not the ideal length to be playing the pull shot! Back of a length on off, Dollar goes for the pull off the front foot but gets beaten.

A chirpy appeal for an LBW turned down! Fullish delivery, shaping in substantially. Gregory tries to play it through but is hit on the pads. Mavi is interested but the umpire stays put. That was sliding down leg.
Good length ball well outside off, holding its line. Dollar plants his front foot across to allow it through.

On the money straightaway! Steams in from over the wicket and bowls a good length ball on off. Generates appreciable inward movement. Dollar tries to account for it but misses to get pinged on the thigh pad. A polite inquiry is turned down.
We are set to get underway. Wesley Madhevere and Gregory Dollar to open the batting for Zimbabwe. Shivam Mavi to start off the proceedings with the ball. One slip and a gully in place. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Sourav Ganguly says that the surface is good for strokeplay. Mentions that there will be good pace and carry on this surface. States that it is a good cricketing pitch and the toss wouldn't matter much.

India skipper, Prithvi Shaw says that they wanted to bat first but it is not a bad toss to lose. States that their bowlers are in good rhythm. Mentions that they need to continue playing with a positive mindset. Reckons that it will be crucial to top the group and that will allow them to get 6 days rest before the quarter-final. Informs there are two changes for India. Riyan Parag comes in for Himanshu Rana and Harvik Desai replaces Aryan Juyal.

Zimbabwe skipper, Nicholas Roche says that they will bat first. Mentions that they have played on this wicket earlier. Adds that it has good pace and bounce. States that they played a 2-match series against New Zealand on this venue before the tournament. Opines that they need to give their best and it is a big opportunity for them. Informs there is one change. Nkosilathi Nungu comes in for Jayden Schadendorf.
TOSS - Zimbabwe win the toss and opt to bat.

Zimbabwe, on the other hand, flourished against a weak Papua New Guinea side but were humbled by the three time world champions, Australia. It is an acid test for them against a soaring opposition and they will need to play out of their skins if they are challenge them. Will the African side spring a surprise and stay in the reckoning for the quarter-finals? Or will the Asian team continue to dominate the proceedings? Expect some youngsters to shine through the ranks!

Hello and a warm welcome to the coverage of game 20 of the Under-19 World Cup in Tauranga. India have been flying high in this tournament as evident from their games against Australia and Papua New Guinea. Clicking together as a unit augers really well from them. When your captain leads from the front, the confident rubs off on the rest of the teammates. That is what is happening with the Men in Blue. Aditya Thakare has been called in as a cover for the injured Ishan Porel and might get a match if the Indians experiment. There is a temptation to test the bench strength but topping the group will also be a priority and that might mean they will stick with the same eleven.
